rules.description: Numpad layer: hold fn + u/i/o j/k/l m/,/. n -> numpad keys
Change spacebar to left_shift. (Post spacebar if pressed alone)
command + right_shift toggles right_shift between escape and shift
ctrl+w/hjkl/s navigation and editing shortcuts in specified apps
Double left_option press to send escape key
Map Command+E to Command+S in Helium
Opt+Q / Opt+D -> history back / forward in Helium
Double left_command to activate combo mode: left_cmd + left_opt + [next key]
left_option twice toggle to get into vim-like hjkl arrows in specified apps
